Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.intro: {units, plural, =0 {No vehicles yet} one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} in {products, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}.
Fleet.searchPlaceholder: Product name, plate or frame number
Fleet.empty: No vehicles yet. Add a product on the Products page, then add your vehicles to it, or import them all from a CSV file.

import.title: Import vehicles from CSV
import.intro: One row per vehicle. The whole file is checked first: if any row has a problem, nothing is saved.
import.columnsHelp: “product” is required: the product’s name, as it is on your Products page. A name you don’t have yet creates the product: give “vehicle_type” (motorbike, car, atv, boat or other; blank means motorbike) and “category” (the choices are under Categories below; required for a motorbike or a car; for several, separate them with a semicolon, like “adventure; touring”). There is no make, model, engine size or transmission column: put the make, model and years in the product’s name or description if you want them. “year” is the vehicle’s own year. Leave “plate” blank for a vehicle without one yet. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; odometer is in {unit}; purchase price is in {currency}.
import.done: Imported {units, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} and {products, plural, =0 {no new products} one {# new product} other {# new products}}.
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} found. Nothing was imported.
